{{Quote|Don't waste my time with flattery, Grammel. Since the Emperor dissolved the Senate, we regional governors have been overwhelmed with work.|Essada, to Grammel|<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye" />}}
[[Moff/Legends|Moff]] '''Bin Essada''' was a [[Near-Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial military]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Circarpous sector/Legends|Circarpous sector]]. After learning from [[Captain-Supervisor]] [[Grammel]] that [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] were present on [[Mimban/Legends|Circarpous V]], he contacted [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

==Biography==
[[File:Grammel_and_Bin_Essada.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Grammel speaks to Bin Essada.]]
{{Quote|I have important ''news'' for you, Lord Vader.|Essada, to Darth Vader|<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye 2">[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye 2|''Splinter of the Mind's Eye'' 2]]</ref>}}
Widely famed as an expert on unusual [[Radiation/Legends|radiations]],<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye" /> [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] Bin Essada<ref name="Fact File">{{FactFile|21|CIR 1-6|Circarpous Joins the Rebellion}}</ref> served as an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]]<ref name="TCSWE" /> presiding over the [[Circarpous sector/Legends|Circarpous sector]],<ref name="Fact File" /> based on the territorial admintrative world of [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]].<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye 2" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="The Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]'' to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].</ref> [[Gender/Legends|he]] received a First Priority communication from [[Captain-Supervisor]] [[Grammel]],<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye 2" /> the commander of the Imperial [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] on [[Mimban/Legends|Circarpous V]], informed him that two strangers had been captured on the planet carrying a [[Kaiburr crystal|strange crystal]]. Just as he showed Essada the fluorescent crystal on the holo connection, the governor became curious, speculating on the phenomenon. Afterwards, he wanted more information about the strangers, and after a description, he concluded that it could be [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], which he did not tell Grammel. He also attributed a possible meaning to her male companion, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], but could not identify him. He ordered Grammel that nothing should happen to the prisoners and was soon to send an [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|important representative]] of the Empire.<ref name="Rebellion">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|What business do you have that requires First Priority with me? It had better be important, Captain-Supervisor Grammel. I know you now.|Essada, to Grammel|<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye" />}}
Essada was an overweight, swarthy man, whose most outstanding feature was a series of chins falling in steps to the upper part of his chest.<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye" /> It was suspected that, while he appeared [[Human/Legends|Human]], his origins may not have [[Near-Human|been so]],<ref name="Rebellion" /> hinted at by<ref name="TCSWE" /> his perpetually squinted dark [[Eye/Legends|eyes]],<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye" /> which featured [[Color/Legends|pink]] pupils<ref name="TCSWE" /> ever sensitive to light.<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye" /> He had curling black [[Hair/Legends|hair]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> touched with white at the sides and dyed orange in a spiral pattern on top.<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye" />
